reference_basis: Andani et al. 2025 V0.8.2 FINAL_VALIDATED2 + V0.8.3 delegated terminology interaction fix
required_interactions: sentence-level English-Chinese pairing and paired highlighting
inline citation popup at citation position
inline figure/table reference opens the corresponding asset
highlighted terminology opens explanation on click, Enter, or Space
terminology interaction works in the bilingual body, right viewer, and dynamically rendered figure-study document
full-screen figure-study with source image and per-panel explanations
reference popups, annotation tools, reader settings, resizing and viewer controls

component_format_contract.principle: Paper-specific content may change, but reader component DOM, class names, typography routing and spacing primitives may not be invented per paper.

supplementary_source_contract.principle: If the article cites supplementary figures or tables that are absent from the uploaded main PDF, the builder must retrieve the final published supplementary material itself before declaring the reader complete.
requirements: use the final published supplement when available rather than an older preprint supplement
obtain the actual supplementary figure/table image or source page
verify numbering against the final article
preserve the official English caption and provide a complete Chinese caption translation
visually inventory every labeled panel and meaningful unlabeled logical block before writing figure-study explanations
make supplementary figure/table mentions clickable at their original in-text position
include supplementary assets in the preview index and right-side viewer
supplementary_source_contract.forbidden_shortcut: The absence of supplementary figures from the user-uploaded main PDF is never sufficient reason to omit them when the article explicitly cites them.

forbidden_regressions: paragraph-level matching in place of sentence-level pairing
figure references moved to paragraph ends
generic figure explanation without panel-by-panel coverage
paper-specific HTML/CSS/JS generated independently instead of using the fixed reader shell
paper-specific replacement markup for fixed hero or overview components
supplementary figures omitted solely because they are not embedded in the uploaded main PDF
